summary.text: Christopher Walis is the Democratic candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Michael Durso.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is 26 and an assistant store manager at Lidl in West Babylon.

paragraphs.text: Walis graduated from West Babylon High School and lists retail management as his profession.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been in the workforce since age 17 and is not a college graduate.
His stated campaign messages are affordability, cleaning up the Great South Bay, and opposing school board actions he described as targeting LGBTQIA students.
He said he is passionate about protecting the rights of transgender youth.
